from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class NonCurrentAssetItem(BaseModel):
    """A line item representing a non-current asset component or total."""
    label: str | None = Field(description="The description of the asset line item as written in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the asset line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount, e.g. 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    is_total_line: bool = Field(description="True if this line item represents the total sum of non-current assets, False if it is a component")

class CompanyReport(BaseModel):
    """Financial report data for a single company."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by the report")
    non_current_assets: list[NonCurrentAssetItem] = Field(description="List of non-current asset line items (components or total)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed financial data from a single document."""
    company_reports: list[CompanyReport]
